_about: ETHERION 카드 일러스트 프롬프트 문구 원본 — n판(2026-11-20, 처음부터 새로 씀). 프롬프트 = 카드 장면(art_scenes/<깃발>.json) + 배색 한 줄 + 깃발 한 줄 + 등급 한 줄 + 화풍 한 줄. 카드끼리 다른 것은 모두 장면에 있고, 여기에는 같은 등급 · 같은 깃발이 함께 쓰는 짧은 말만 둔다. 고치면 version을 올리고 node tools/art/build_prompts.js. 모든 등급이 n판이다(옛 g4 프롬프트는 legacy_g4/에 보관만).

lead.spell: Landscape 5:4 painting of a spell — the magic itself is the subject.
lead.item: Landscape 5:4 painting of one object — the object itself is the subject.

house: ETHERION card art — painterly dark-fantasy illustration: confident visible brushwork, deep shadow masses, luminous colour, a clear shape that reads at small size. Painting only, edge to edge, no lettering — the game adds its own frame and text.
upgradeRef: Continuity: the same individual as in the attached reference picture, now promoted — same body, face, markings and colours, grown stronger.

token.idea_ko: 마법이 방금 불러낸 것. 단순하고 또렷하게, 아직 흩어지지 않은 에테르 푸른빛이 가장자리에 남아 있다.
token.finish: Summoned: simple and luminous — a thing called up a heartbeat ago, its edges still trailing ether-blue (#8fdcff) light.

common.idea_ko: 있는 그대로의 세계. 지켜본 듯한 평범한 한순간, 장면 안의 광원 하나, 꾸밈없는 재질, 절제한 색. 화려한 장식 없이도 카드마다 다른 그림.
common.finish: Common: the world as it is — plainly observed, one natural light source, weathered plain materials, restrained colour.

uncommon.idea_ko: 솜씨와 숙련. 더 또렷하고 정교한 묘사, 윤곽을 따는 두 번째 빛, 모서리에 따뜻한 금빛이 몇 점.
uncommon.finish: Superior: assured craft — crisper, finer detail, a clean second light picking out the edges, a few warm-gold (#f2cf3d) glints.

rare.idea_ko: 되풀이해 이야기할 만한 순간. 더 대담한 연출과 깊은 공간, 또렷한 명암, 윤곽에 차가운 사파이어 빛과 떠도는 에테르 알갱이 몇 점.
rare.finish: Rare: a moment worth retelling — bolder staging and deeper space, crisp contrast, a cool sapphire (#4ea8ff) rim light and a few drifting ether motes.

upgrade.idea_ko: 원래 카드의 그 개체가 한 단계 오른 모습. 원래 카드 그림을 함께 넣고 그린다. 보강한 몸 · 장비, 발밑에서 오르는 청록빛.
upgrade.finish: Empowered: the same individual risen a rank — sturdier body and reinforced gear, steadier bearing, teal (#3fe0c0) energy rising from the ground beneath it.

epic.idea_ko: 세계가 반응한다. 날씨 · 대기 · 깊이가 움직이고 빛이 공기를 가른다. 공기 속에 옅은 보랏빛 비술 입자. 시점은 카드마다 다르다(늘 올려다보지 않는다).
epic.finish: Epic: the world itself reacts — moving weather, deep atmosphere and distance, shafts of light through the air, faint violet (#b46cff) arcane motes.

unique.idea_ko: 깃발의 이름난 전설 한 장면. 그 깃발에서 가장 대담한 그림 — 연극 같은 명암, 장인의 세공, 녹은 주황 금빛 불티.
unique.finish: Unique: one legend's defining image, the most daring picture of its banner — theatrical chiaroscuro, masterwork detail, molten orange-gold (#ff8a2a) embers and filigree light.

special.idea_ko: 눈에 보이는 신화. 깃발마다 하나뿐인 존재(유닛)와 성소의 유물(아이템) — 필멸의 크기를 넘고, 땅과 하늘이 그 둘레에서 휜다. 겹겹의 광휘, 진홍과 금.
special.finish: Special: myth made visible — one of a kind and beyond mortal scale, land and sky bending around it, layered radiance in crimson (#ff4d73) and gold.

B1.world: Banner of fire: a volcanic country warmed from below by a sleeping giant's heart-fire — basalt, obsidian, magma seams, drifting embers, soot and powder smoke.

palettes.ember: embers in the dark — near-black and soot-brown, with small fierce glows of fire-orange (#ff6b3d)
palettes.whitehot: white-hot — a blinding yellow-white core falling through fire-orange (#ff6b3d) into deep crimson shadow
palettes.ashfall: ashfall — pale ash-grey and bone-white, muted, with one fierce accent of fire-orange (#ff6b3d)
palettes.magmadusk: magma dusk — wine-red and violet-brown gloom glowing fire-orange (#ff6b3d) from below
palettes.coldnight: cold night against fire — deep blue-indigo dark cut by warm fire-orange (#ff6b3d) light
palettes.brassglow: furnace warmth — brass, copper and amber tones in sooty brown gloom, fire-orange (#ff6b3d) at the heart

B1.founder: goblin — small wiry body, huge pointed ears, sharp grin, soot-smeared grey-green skin, scorched leather apron, goggles pushed up; gunner of cannons, muskets and powder kegs

B2.world: Banner of metal: mountains whose ore veins are a sleeping giant's iron sinews — raw ore, hammered steel, rivets, slag, forge-glow and the cold of deep halls.

palettes.coldsteel: cold steel — blue-grey (#a9b4c2) and slate shadow with crisp white highlights
palettes.forgeheart: forge heart — dark gunmetal and steel grey (#a9b4c2) with molten orange glowing in the seams
palettes.patina: rust and verdigris — red-brown and green-blue patina over steel grey (#a9b4c2) in dim light
palettes.snowlight: mountain daylight — overcast snow-white and granite grey with steel-grey (#a9b4c2) metal
palettes.lamplit: lamplight underground — small warm pools of light in black, steel grey (#a9b4c2) glinting at the edges
palettes.mirror: mirror polish — bright silver-grey (#a9b4c2) reflections of a dark world, almost monochrome

locales: shield wall on a mountain pass
B2.founder: dwarf — stocky and broad, braided iron-grey beard, thick riveted plate, hammer or shield; smith of golems and automatons

B3.world: Banner of lightning: a storm plateau where a sleeping giant's nerves spark up through the ground — forked bolts, fulgurite glass, copper, glass jars of captive lightning, rain and ozone haze.

palettes.thunderhead: thunderhead — black and rain-grey split by searing electric yellow (#ffd84a)
palettes.cobalt: cobalt night — deep blue dark with electric-yellow (#ffd84a) arcs and violet-white coronas
palettes.copperlab: copper warmth — copper, amber glass and electric-yellow (#ffd84a) filament glow
palettes.flash: the flash — bleached white-yellow (#ffd84a) overexposure with hard black shapes
palettes.greensky: storm green — eerie flat yellow-green light before the strike, with a few electric-yellow (#ffd84a) sparks
palettes.wetglass: rain grey — pale grey wet reflections with small electric-yellow (#ffd84a) sparks doubled in them

locales: wet cobbled street under hanging wires
B3.founder: gnome — tiny, big nose, wild hair, brass goggles, lab coat with many pockets; scholar-engineer of coils and lightning jars

G1.world: Banner of earth: wind-scoured steppe and broken highlands on the back of a mountain-sized earth dragon — raw rock, dry clay, dust, bone, hide and tall dry grass.

palettes.ochredust: ochre dust — matte sandstone and clay browns (#b88a5a) in a sunlit dust haze
palettes.bonemoon: bone and moon — bone-white and grey-blue night with dry ochre (#b88a5a) earth
palettes.redearth: red earth — rust-red clay under slate-grey storm light, ochre (#b88a5a) dust in the air
palettes.strawgold: dry-grass afternoon — pale straw and ochre (#b88a5a) with long umber shadows
palettes.stormslate: steppe storm — slate grey and muted earth brown (#b88a5a), flying grit
palettes.firelit: firelit dark — deep darkness with warm ochre (#b88a5a) surfaces lit by one small flame

locales: the dragon's back — boulders and pines
G1.founder: orc — powerful and heavy-fisted, tusks, scarred grey-green skin, rust-red war paint, braided hair, bone and hide gear

G2.world: Banner of forest: a primeval wood kept by an antlered forest dragon — giant roots, moss, bark, thorns, fungi, vines and wounds that grow closed.

palettes.mossdeep: deep moss — saturated leaf-green (#58b85f) in heavy shade with wet bark browns
palettes.sporeglow: spore night — black dark lit by blue-green and pale-lime (#58b85f) bioluminescence
palettes.sunshaft: canopy light — golden-green (#58b85f) shafts through drifting mist
palettes.autumnrot: autumn rot — russet, amber and mushroom-pale against dark leaf-green (#58b85f)
palettes.rainmist: rain mist — grey-green (#58b85f) haze and soft silver light
palettes.thorndark: thorn dark — near-black with deep green (#58b85f) and a few points of blood red

G2.founder: moss troll — very tall and lanky, long moss-covered limbs, bark-like skin, slow and patient

G3.world: Banner of water: lagoons, tides and deep sea that answer a sea dragon's song — clear water, foam, pearl, coral, kelp and sound made visible as ripples.

palettes.lagoon: sunlit shallows — turquoise and water-blue (#4fb3ff) with pearl white, clear and bright over deep blue shadow
palettes.trench: deep water — navy and black with small cold lights and a water-blue (#4fb3ff) glow
palettes.moontide: moon tide — silver-blue (#4fb3ff) moonlight and pale mist
palettes.coraldawn: coral dawn — coral pink and warm first light over water-blue (#4fb3ff)
palettes.stormsea: storm sea — heavy green-blue (#4fb3ff), white spray and slate grey
palettes.glasscalm: glass calm — mirror-still pale blue-grey (#4fb3ff) and fog, almost monochrome

G3.founder: merfolk — blue-scaled, long flowing fins, pearl and shell ornaments; shrine singer of the lagoon

A1.world: Banner of darkness: a sunless canyon under a moonless sky, ruled by a god of price — shadow, obsidian, candle smoke, wax seals, scales, chains and blood paid as coin.

palettes.violetshade: violet shade — purple-black gloom with luminous violet (#8b5cf6) edges
palettes.bloodink: blood and ink — black and deep crimson with a thread of violet (#8b5cf6)
palettes.candle: candle islands — small pools of amber light in vast dark, violet (#8b5cf6) in the shadows
palettes.bonepale: bone pale — ash-grey and bone-white drained of colour, with one violet (#8b5cf6) glow
palettes.eclipse: eclipse — a thin cold rim of light with everything else in silhouette, violet (#8b5cf6) haze
palettes.frostindigo: indigo frost — cold blue-violet (#8b5cf6) night air and tarnished silver

A1.founder: demon contractor — curved horns, ashen or pale skin, glowing eyes, elegant dark attire; signs and collects contracts in blood

A2.world: Banner of light: a white citadel facing the first light of day, held together by oaths — pale stone, stained glass, candle wax, gilded shields, feathers and sunbeams with weight.

palettes.firstlight: first light — cool blue-grey before dawn with a low band of pale gold (#ffe9a8)
palettes.whitegold: white and gold — sunlit ivory and soft pale gold (#ffe9a8), airy, with cool blue shadow
palettes.stainedglass: stained glass — jewel-coloured patches of light on pale stone in deep shade, pale-gold (#ffe9a8) beams
palettes.vigil: night vigil — darkness holding small warm flames with pale-gold (#ffe9a8) halos
palettes.rosedawn: rose dawn — pink-gold (#ffe9a8) cloud light and lilac shadows
palettes.glare: holy glare — blinding white-gold (#ffe9a8) light with dark shapes in front of it

locales: the long wall facing the empty land
A2.founder: seraph — human-like, white feathered wings, a thin halo, pale armour or robes; shield-bearer of the dawn

A3.world: Banner of wind: needle spires and drifting sky-islands above the clouds, where the stars are read like a book — thin air, feathers, silver, taut bowstrings, star charts and open night sky.

palettes.starindigo: star indigo — deep indigo night full of stars, wind-teal (#9fe3d6) streaks and silver
palettes.thinair: thin air — pale high-altitude daylight, white cloud and cool shadow, wind-teal (#9fe3d6) accents
palettes.aurora: aurora — teal-green (#9fe3d6) and violet ribbons of light over darkness
palettes.stormcloud: storm cloud — grey-violet cloud and silver rain with wind-teal (#9fe3d6) gusts
palettes.duskrose: dusk above the clouds — rose and peach light with deep teal (#9fe3d6) shadows
palettes.moonsilver: moon silver — blue-silver monochrome under a full moon, sharp shadows, a breath of teal (#9fe3d6)

A3.founder: high elf — slender and proud, long pointed ears, silver hair, short wind-blown cloak and light leather; archer with a long elegant bow

shots._about: 장면의 틀 낱말. 장면 지시의 shot에 하나를 적고, 글(scene)에는 그 뜻을 풀어 쓴다. w = 한 깃발 안에서 고르게 돌릴 때의 몫(scene_tool.js가 제안을 나눠 줄 때 씀). 검사(scene_tool.js lint)는 한 깃발 안에서 같은 낱말이 몰리지 않는지 본다.

eye.en: eye level at a natural distance, as if standing beside it

close.en: tight close-up — head or upper body fills the frame

high.en: from above, looking down at it

back.en: from behind it, seeing what it faces

profile.en: strict side view, flat like a frieze

ground.en: camera on the ground, through grass, rubble or feet

far.en: far away — the subject small inside a wide place

over.en: over the shoulder of it, or of whoever faces it

through.en: glimpsed through an opening or obstruction — bars, reeds, flames, a doorway, ribs

silhouette.en: backlit black shape against light; the outline tells everything

macro.en: extreme close detail — an eye, a claw, a hand at work — the rest implied

pov.en: first person — the viewer is its prey, target or handler

reflect.en: seen as a reflection or a cast shadow — in a puddle, a blade, on a wall

under.en: from below a surface, looking up through water, a grate or a pit mouth

cut.en: cross-section — burrow, hollow trunk, tunnel or shell opened to view

swarm.en: many bodies fill the frame edge to edge as a pattern

inside.en: from inside something, looking out past it — a mouth, a barrel, a cave, a lantern

echo.en: one movement shown as several overlapping moments in a single frame

low.en: from low down, looking up — used sparingly

impact.en: the instant of impact at close range

after.en: the aftermath — what is left, still glowing or smoking

path.en: its travel across the frame, seen from the side

before.en: the held breath just before it happens

top.en: straight overhead — its footprint on the ground

far.en: far away — the phenomenon against land and sky

macro.en: extreme close-up of the magic's own matter

origin.en: looking along its line of travel from where it began

through.en: framed by an opening — a doorway, a breach, a ribcage of ruin

reflect.en: seen as a reflection or as shadows thrown on a wall

cut.en: cross-section of ground, water or air with the magic moving inside

column.en: one tall vertical — a pillar, a fall, an ascent

swarm.en: many small elements filling the frame

symbol.en: an emblematic arrangement of things that stands for the effect

under.en: from underneath, looking up at it

inside.en: from inside the phenomenon, looking out

used.en: where it was just used — stuck, smoking, dripping, embedded

stored.en: in its place of keeping — hook, rack, chest, niche, saddlebag

found.en: lost or abandoned — half-buried, underwater, in grass

macro.en: extreme close-up of its one telling detail

top.en: straight overhead, laid out with its accessories

making.en: half-made — on the anvil, in the mould, on the loom

stand.en: on a stand, post, statue or empty armour — the wearer implied

through.en: glimpsed through something — wrapping, bars, ice, a keyhole

reflect.en: the world reflected in its surface

cut.en: cutaway or exploded view of its inner workings

nature.en: claimed by its element — overgrown, encrusted, charged, half-melted

pair.en: beside the one thing that explains it

motion.en: caught in mid-air — thrown, falling, spinning

bench.en: on the maker's bench among tools

hand.en: one hand, claw or paw holding or wearing it, cropped at the wrist — used sparingly

dirs._about: 주인공이 향하거나 움직이는 쪽(dir). 한 깃발의 유닛은 L · R이 비슷해야 한다.
dirs.N: no facing — radial, still or all over

places._about: 화면에서 주인공 덩어리가 놓인 자리(place). 가운데(C)만 쓰지 않는다.
